name: Fire Covenant
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life.
Fire Covenant deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures.
blocked_sentences: Fire Covenant deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures.

needs.what: divided damage whose amount is the announced X (here X from an additional pay_life_x cost): the cast line must announce X before (or cap) the 'any number' target declaration so the 601.2d division is asked over at most X targets, each dealt at least 1
needs.why_existing_wont_do: additional_cost {pay_life_x: true} (Toxic Deluge) covers the first sentence and damage with 'divided' covers fixed or board-derived amounts (Pyrokinesis, Monstrous Onslaught), but the loader explicitly refuses a divided amount that reads the announced X ('a divided amount may not read the announced X') because targets are declared before X on this engine's cast line, and game._cast asks pay_life_x's X only after mana is paid
